# vim: set sts=2 ts=8 sw=2 tw=99 et ft=python:
import json
import os


class MMSPluginConfig(object):
  def __init__(self):
    metamod_source = getattr(builder.options, 'metamod_source', None)
    if not metamod_source:
      metamod_source = os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'metamod-source')
    self.mms_root = self.requireDirectory(
      metamod_source, 'Metamod:Source')
    manifests_root = self.requireDirectory(
      os.path.join(self.mms_root, 'hl2sdk-manifests'), 'HL2SDK manifests')

    self.sdk_helpers = builder.Eval(os.path.join(manifests_root, 'SdkHelpers.ambuild'), {
      'Project': 'metamod'
    })
    self.sdk_manifests = []
    self.sdk_target = None
    self.binaries = []
    self.version_header_deps = []
    self.metadata = self.loadMetadata()

    self.target = builder.DetectCxx(target_arch='x86_64')
    if self.target.target.arch != 'x86_64':
      raise Exception('AntiCheat only builds for x86_64.')
    if self.target.target.platform == 'windows' and self.target.family != 'msvc':
      raise Exception('The Windows build needs the Microsoft C++ compiler.')
    if self.target.target.platform == 'linux' and self.target.family != 'clang':
      raise Exception('The Linux build needs Clang.')
    if self.target.target.platform not in ('windows', 'linux'):
      raise Exception('AntiCheat only builds for Windows or Linux.')

  @staticmethod
  def requireDirectory(path, description):
    path = os.path.abspath(os.path.normpath(path))
    if not os.path.isdir(path):
      raise Exception('{} is missing at {}.'.format(description, path))
    return path

  def loadMetadata(self):
    path = os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'plugin-metadata.json')
    builder.AddConfigureFile(path)
    with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as fp:
      metadata = json.load(fp)

    required = (
      'name', 'alias', 'display_name', 'description', 'author',
      'url', 'log_tag', 'license', 'version'
    )
    missing = [key for key in required if key not in metadata]
    if missing:
      raise Exception('plugin-metadata.json is missing: {}.'.format(', '.join(missing)))
    if metadata['name'] != 'AntiCheat' or metadata['alias'] != 'AntiCheat':
      raise Exception('The plugin name and MetaMod alias must both be AntiCheat.')
    if metadata['version'] != '1.0.0':
      raise Exception('The AntiCheat version must be 1.0.0.')
    return metadata

  def findSdkPath(self, sdk_name):
    path = os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'hl2sdk-{}'.format(sdk_name))
    return path if os.path.isdir(path) else None

  def detectSDK(self):
    self.sdk_helpers.find_sdk_path = self.findSdkPath
    self.sdk_helpers.findSdks(builder, [self.target], ['cs2'])
    self.sdk_manifests = self.sdk_helpers.sdk_manifests
    self.sdk_target = self.sdk_helpers.sdk_targets[0]

  def generateVersionHeader(self):
    def value(key):
      return json.dumps(self.metadata[key])

    contents = '''#ifndef AntiCheat_VERSION_GEN_H
#define AntiCheat_VERSION_GEN_H

#define PLUGIN_NAME {name}
#define PLUGIN_ALIAS {alias}
#define PLUGIN_DISPLAY_NAME {display_name}
#define PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION {description}
#define PLUGIN_AUTHOR {author}
#define PLUGIN_URL {url}
#define PLUGIN_LOGTAG {log_tag}
#define PLUGIN_LICENSE {license}
#define PLUGIN_FULL_VERSION {version}
#define PLUGIN_REVISION_SHORT "0"
#define PLUGIN_REVISION_LONG "0"
#define PLUGIN_REVISION_COUNT "0"

#endif
'''.format(**{key: value(key) for key in self.metadata})

    builder.SetBuildFolder('/')
    self.version_header_deps = [
      builder.AddOutputFile(
        os.path.join('versioning', 'version_gen.h'), contents.encode('utf-8'))
    ]

  def configureCXX(self, cxx):
    if cxx.target.platform == 'linux':
      cxx.defines += [
        'stricmp=strcasecmp',
        '_stricmp=strcasecmp',
        '_snprintf=snprintf',
        '_vsnprintf=vsnprintf',
        'HAVE_STDINT_H',
        'GNUC',
        'LINUX',
        '_LINUX',
        'POSIX',
        '_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64',
      ]
      cxx.cflags += [
        '-pipe',
        '-fno-strict-aliasing',
        '-Wall',
        '-Werror',
        '-Wno-sign-compare',
        '-Wno-uninitialized',
        '-Wno-unused',
        '-Wno-switch',
        '-fPIC',
        '-fvisibility=hidden',
        '-fno-omit-frame-pointer',
      ]
      cxx.cxxflags += [
        '-std=c++17',
        '-fno-exceptions',
        '-frtti',
        '-fno-threadsafe-statics',
        '-fvisibility-inlines-hidden',
        '-Wno-delete-non-virtual-dtor',
        '-Wno-non-virtual-dtor',
        '-Wno-overloaded-virtual',
        '-Wno-register',
        '-Wno-invalid-offsetof',
        '-Wno-parentheses',
      ]
      cxx.linkflags += ['-fuse-ld=lld', '-Wl,--no-gnu-unique', '-static-libstdc++', '-lgcc_eh']
    else:
      cxx.defines += [
        '_CRT_SECURE_NO_DEPRECATE',
        '_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS',
        '_CRT_NONSTDC_NO_DEPRECATE',
        '_HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0',
        '_ITERATOR_DEBUG_LEVEL=0',
        'WIN32',
        '_WINDOWS',
      ]
      cxx.cflags += [
        '/MT', '/W3', '/WX', '/wd4005', '/wd4018', '/wd4099', '/wd4146',
        '/wd4244', '/wd4267', '/wd5033', '/wd5048', '/std:c++17', '/Oy-',
        '/experimental:deterministic',
        '/pathmap:{}=AntiCheat'.format(builder.sourcePath),
      ]
      cxx.cxxflags += ['/TP']
      cxx.linkflags += ['/WX', '/IGNORE:4099', '/NODEFAULTLIB:MSVCRT']
      if builder.options.debug != '1':
        cxx.linkflags += ['/DEBUG:NONE']

    if builder.options.opt == '1':
      cxx.defines += ['NDEBUG']
      if cxx.target.platform == 'linux':
        cxx.cflags += ['-O3']
      else:
        cxx.cflags += ['/Ox']
        cxx.linkflags += ['/OPT:ICF', '/OPT:REF']

    if builder.options.debug == '1':
      cxx.defines += ['DEBUG', '_DEBUG']
      if cxx.target.platform == 'linux':
        cxx.cflags += ['-g3']
      else:
        cxx.cflags += ['/Od', '/RTC1', '/Zi']

  def HL2Library(self, context, compiler, name, sdk, static=False):
    binary = compiler.StaticLibrary(name) if static else compiler.Library(name)
    cxx = binary.compiler
    if builder.options.debug != '1':
      cxx.symbol_files_ = None
    self.configureCXX(cxx)

    cxx.includes += [os.path.join(builder.buildPath, 'versioning')]
    cxx.sourcedeps += self.version_header_deps
    cxx.cxxincludes += [
      context.currentSourcePath,
      os.path.join(self.mms_root, 'core'),
      os.path.join(self.mms_root, 'core', 'sourcehook'),
    ]

    for manifest in self.sdk_manifests:
      cxx.defines += ['SE_{}={}'.format(manifest['define'], manifest['code'])]

    cxx.defines += ['META_IS_SOURCE2']
    # CS2's current manifest omits these directories although SDK headers
    # include their contents by unqualified names.
    cxx.cxxincludes += [
      os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'public', 'engine'),
      os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'public', 'tier1'),
    ]
    binary.sources += [
      os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'tier1', 'convar.cpp'),
      os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'public', 'tier0', 'memoverride.cpp'),
    ]
    self.sdk_helpers.configureCxx(context, binary, sdk)
    return binary


MMSPlugin = MMSPluginConfig()
MMSPlugin.detectSDK()
MMSPlugin.generateVersionHeader()

builder.Build(['AMBuilder', 'PackageScript'], {'MMSPlugin': MMSPlugin})

```

# vim: set sts=2 ts=8 sw=2 tw=99 et ft=python:
import os


def collectPluginSources(platform):
  sources = []
  source_root = os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'src')
  for root, _, filenames in os.walk(source_root):
    for filename in filenames:
      if not filename.endswith('.cpp'):
        continue
      if root.endswith(os.path.join('clientcvar', 'dynlibutils')) and filename in ('module_windows.cpp', 'module_linux.cpp'):
        continue
      if platform == 'windows' and filename.endswith('_linux.cpp'):
        continue
      if platform == 'linux' and filename.endswith(('_win.cpp', '_windows.cpp')):
        continue
      sources.append(os.path.join(root, filename))
  return sorted(sources)


def createProtobufLibrary(sdk_target, sdk, cxx):
  sources = [
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'common', 'valveextensions.proto'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'common', 'network_connection.proto'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'common', 'networkbasetypes.proto'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'common', 'source2_steam_stats.proto'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'common', 'netmessages.proto'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'game', 'shared', 'gameevents.proto'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'game', 'shared', 'usermessages.proto'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'game', 'shared', 'usercmd.proto'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'game', 'shared', 'cs', 'cs_gameevents.proto'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'game', 'shared', 'cs', 'cs_usercmd.proto'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'networksystem', 'networksystem_protomessages.proto'),
  ]
  protoc = builder.tools.Protoc(protoc=sdk_target.protoc, sources=sources)
  protoc.protoc.includes += [
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'thirdparty', 'protobuf-3.21.8', 'src'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'common'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'game', 'shared'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'game', 'shared', 'cs'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'networksystem'),
  ]
  protoc.protoc.includes = [path for path in protoc.protoc.includes if os.path.isdir(path)]

  binary = MMSPlugin.HL2Library(builder, cxx, 'AntiCheat-protobuf', sdk, static=True)
  if binary.compiler.family in ('gcc', 'clang'):
    binary.compiler.defines += ['_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0']
  binary.custom = [protoc]
  return builder.Add(binary).binary


sdk_target = MMSPlugin.sdk_target
sdk = sdk_target.sdk
cxx = sdk_target.cxx

protobuf = createProtobufLibrary(sdk_target, sdk, cxx)
binary = MMSPlugin.HL2Library(builder, cxx, MMSPlugin.metadata['name'], sdk)

if binary.compiler.family in ('gcc', 'clang'):
  binary.compiler.defines += ['_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0']

if builder.options.opt == '1' and builder.options.debug != '1' and cxx.target.platform == 'linux':
  binary.compiler.linkflags += ['-Wl,-s']

binary.compiler.cxxincludes += [
  os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'metamod-source', 'third_party', 'khook', 'include'),
  os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'src'),
  os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'src', 'clientcvar'),
  os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'src', 'clientcvar', 'dynlibutils'),
  os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'hl2sdk-cs2'),
  os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'hl2sdk-cs2', 'public', 'entity2'),
  os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'hl2sdk-cs2', 'game', 'server'),
  os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'vendor', 'funchook', 'include'),
  os.path.join(builder.buildPath, 'AntiCheat-protobuf',
               '{}-{}'.format(cxx.target.platform, cxx.target.arch)),
]

binary.sources += [
  os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'entity2', 'entityidentity.cpp'),
  os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'entity2', 'entitysystem.cpp'),
]
binary.sources += collectPluginSources(cxx.target.platform)
binary.compiler.postlink.insert(0, protobuf)
binary.compiler.sourcedeps += [protobuf]

if cxx.target.platform == 'windows':
  binary.compiler.postlink += [
    'psapi.lib',
    os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'vendor', 'funchook', 'lib', 'funchook.lib'),
    os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'vendor', 'funchook', 'lib', 'distorm.lib'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'lib', 'public', 'win64', 'mathlib.lib'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'lib', 'public', 'win64', 'steam_api64.lib'),
    'delayimp.lib',
  ]
  binary.compiler.linkflags += ['/DELAYLOAD:steam_api64.dll']
else:
  binary.compiler.postlink += [
    os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'vendor', 'funchook', 'lib', 'libfunchook.a'),
    os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'vendor', 'funchook', 'lib', 'libdistorm.a'),
    os.path.join(sdk['path'], 'lib', 'linux64', 'mathlib.a'),
  ]

MMSPlugin.binaries = [builder.Add(binary)]

`AntiCheat/README.md`:

```md
# AntiCheat 1.0.0

![AntiCheat logo](../docs/AntiCheat-logo.svg)

AntiCheat 1.0.0 is maintained by GSM-RO. Existing copyright notices and licenses for inherited and third-party code remain in force.

## Linux x86-64 build

The Linux build uses Steam Runtime 3 SDK image `registry.gitlab.steamos.cloud/steamrt/sniper/sdk@sha256:2969e5a47146a6494c01d953cd818b1d62712f42f9e54c4809d7a3aa8dc276ce` and AMBuild commit `d89ec91a7ac2607da07b50bb62346f9a10e9a998`. A Windows host needs Docker Desktop with its Linux engine, Git, Python 3, the prepared CS2 SDK, and pinned AMBuild checkout. Linux hosts need Docker, Git, Python 3, and the same prepared source/build inputs.

Use an isolated MetaMod:Source checkout at **2.0.0.1483**, commit `170058a2f0dbd58106b7c76bfe88a94672295356`, with its recursive submodules initialized. AlliedModders lists Counter-Strike 2 as requiring current-development MetaMod:Source; confirm the target against the [official required-version table](https://wiki.alliedmods.net/Required_Versions_(SourceMod)) and [development snapshots](https://www.metamodsource.net/downloads.php/?branch=dev).

From the repository root in PowerShell:

```powershell
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\build-linux.ps1 `
  -BuildDirectory 'AntiCheat/build-linux-release' `
  -MetaModSourceDirectory 'C:\tools\metamod-source-2.0.0.1483' `
  -SkipBootstrap
```

On Linux, use the equivalent wrapper:

```sh
./build-linux.sh AntiCheat/build-linux-release /opt/metamod-source-2.0.0.1483 --skip-bootstrap
```

The output package is under `AntiCheat/<build-directory>/package`. The plugin binary is `AntiCheat.so` at `game/csgo/addons/AntiCheat/bin/linuxsteamrt64/AntiCheat.so`. The MetaMod loader alias is `AntiCheat`, and the configuration and gamedata files use the same project name. The package includes `COPYRIGHT.md`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, and applicable license files under `game/csgo/addons/AntiCheat/licenses`.

## Copyright and licensing

Copyright (c) 2026 GSM-RO for original AntiCheat modifications contributed for this release. This attribution does not claim ownership of inherited code or third-party components; their copyright notices and licenses remain applicable.

The repository currently has a licensing mismatch: `plugin-metadata.json` identifies AGPL-3.0, while the root `LICENSE` file contains GNU GPL version 3 text. This rebrand preserves both existing materials and does not resolve or change the project's governing license. Confirm the correct project license with the relevant rights holders before redistributing.

Choose a fresh build-directory name if that output already exists. The separate `package-source.py` source-archive operation requires a clean tracked tree and valid pinned dependency checkouts; it is not required for the Linux runtime package build.

```

# vim: set sts=2 ts=8 sw=2 tw=99 et ft=python:
import os


builder.SetBuildFolder('package')

if len(MMSPlugin.binaries) != 1:
  raise Exception('AntiCheat must produce exactly one plugin binary.')

cxx = MMSPlugin.sdk_target.cxx
platform_folder = {
  'windows': 'win64',
  'linux': 'linuxsteamrt64',
}[cxx.target.platform]

addons_root = os.path.join('game', 'csgo', 'addons')
cfg_root = os.path.join('game', 'csgo', 'cfg')
plugin_root = os.path.join(addons_root, 'AntiCheat')
bin_path = os.path.join(plugin_root, 'bin', platform_folder)
metamod_path = os.path.join(addons_root, 'metamod')
gamedata_path = os.path.join(plugin_root, 'gamedata')
licenses_path = os.path.join(plugin_root, 'licenses')
translations_path = os.path.join(plugin_root, 'translations')
builder.AddFolder(bin_path)
builder.AddFolder(metamod_path)
gamedata_folder = builder.AddFolder(gamedata_path)
builder.AddFolder(licenses_path)
translations_folder = builder.AddFolder(translations_path)
cfg_folder = builder.AddFolder(cfg_root)

task = MMSPlugin.binaries[0]
extension = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(task.binary.path))[1]
plugin_name = MMSPlugin.metadata['name']
plugin_alias = MMSPlugin.metadata['alias']
builder.AddCopy(task.binary, os.path.join(bin_path, plugin_name + extension))
builder.AddCopy(
  os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'gamedata', 'AntiCheat.games.txt'),
  gamedata_folder
)
builder.AddCopy(
  os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'cfg', 'AntiCheat.cfg'),
  cfg_folder
)
for filename in sorted(os.listdir(os.path.join(builder.sourcePath,
                                                'translations'))):
  if filename.endswith('.txt'):
    builder.AddCopy(
      os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'translations', filename),
      translations_folder
    )
builder.AddCopy(
  os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md'),
  os.path.join(plugin_root, 'THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md')
)
builder.AddCopy(
  os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, 'COPYRIGHT.md'),
  os.path.join(plugin_root, 'COPYRIGHT.md')
)
for source, target in (
  ('LICENSE', 'AntiCheat-GPL-3.0.txt'),
  (os.path.join('licenses', 'CLIENTCVARVALUE-GPL-3.0.txt'),
   'CLIENTCVARVALUE-GPL-3.0.txt'),
  (os.path.join('licenses', 'DYNLIBUTILS-MIT.txt'), 'DYNLIBUTILS-MIT.txt'),
  (os.path.join('licenses', 'CS2KZ-AGPL-3.0.txt'), 'CS2KZ-AGPL-3.0.txt'),
  (os.path.join('licenses', 'FUNCHOOK.txt'), 'FUNCHOOK.txt'),
  (os.path.join('licenses', 'DISTORM.txt'), 'DISTORM.txt'),
  (os.path.join('licenses', 'PICOSHA2-MIT.txt'), 'PICOSHA2-MIT.txt'),
  (os.path.join('licenses', 'MINIZ-MIT.txt'), 'MINIZ-MIT.txt'),
  (os.path.join(MMSPlugin.mms_root, 'LICENSE.txt'), 'METAMOD-SOURCE.txt'),
  (os.path.join('hl2sdk-cs2', 'thirdparty', 'protobuf-3.21.8', 'LICENSE'),
   'PROTOBUF.txt'),
):
  builder.AddCopy(
    os.path.join(builder.sourcePath, source),
    os.path.join(licenses_path, target)
  )

vdf = '''"Metamod Plugin"
{{
\t"alias"\t"{}"
\t"file"\t"addons/AntiCheat/bin/{}/{}"
}}
'''.format(plugin_alias, platform_folder, plugin_name)
builder.AddOutputFile(os.path.join(metamod_path, plugin_alias + '.vdf'), vdf.encode('utf-8'))

`README.md`:

```md
# AntiCheat

<div align="center">

![AntiCheat logo](docs/AntiCheat-logo.svg)

AntiCheat watches the aim, shots, movement, button presses, and game settings that players send to the server. When it finds enough strong evidence, it reports the player and can ask the server to punish them.

</div>

## Quickstart

You need a Windows x64 or Linux x64 CS2 dedicated server running [Metamod:Source](https://www.sourcemm.net/) 2.x.

1. Open this repository's **Releases** tab and choose the matching Windows or Linux package.
2. Extract it into the CS2 server root without rearranging anything. The package begins with the `game` folder.
3. Edit `game/csgo/cfg/AntiCheat.cfg`.
4. Start the server.
5. Run `meta list`, then `AntiCheat_status`.

That is it. Players install nothing.

The default punishment commands are made for [CS2-SimpleAdmin](https://github.com/daffyyyy/CS2-SimpleAdmin). If your server uses another admin plugin, replace the two commands in `AntiCheat.cfg` with commands that plugin understands.

## Administrator and server-console commands

Run these commands from the dedicated-server console or through RCON. `AntiCheat_help` prints the built-in command list.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `AntiCheat_status` | Show plugin status, connected-player counts, enabled detectors, announcements, punishments, and webhook state. |
| `AntiCheat_help` | Print the administrator command list. |
| `AntiCheat_reload` | Reload and validate `AntiCheat.cfg`; clears transient detector evidence after the reload completes. |
| `AntiCheat_check_config` | Check current settings and report configuration problems without changing them. |
| `AntiCheat_test_announcement` | Send a harmless chat and center-screen announcement test. |
| `AntiCheat_webhook_test` | Send a harmless test report to configured Discord and JSON webhooks. |

## Detection output

When a detector finds enough evidence, AntiCheat can report the result wherever the server owner needs it:

1. Announce it in public chat.
2. Hold a center-screen alert for three seconds.
3. Write the detector evidence to the server console.
4. Submit the configured ban or kick command to the server.
5. Send a detailed Discord webhook report.

Chat and center-screen announcements can be turned on or off separately. AntiCheat sends the chosen ban or kick command to the server. The installed admin plugin must understand and run that command.

```text
[AntiCheat] detected AIMBOT on Player and punished.
```

Whitelisted players can still be detected and reported, but AntiCheat stops before submitting a punishment command. Disabled output channels stay quiet.

## Detection modules

All 18 modules are enabled by default, and each one can be turned off. Open **How strict is it?** to see its main rule. These numbers come from the current code and cannot be changed in the config.

### Aim and accuracy

**Aimbot.** An aimbot can quickly move the crosshair onto an enemy just before it shoots. AntiCheat checks where the player was aiming before and after a damaging shot, and how close the snap moved to the enemy.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

Any three suspicious one-command snaps, snap-returns, or matching smooth aim curves before damaging shots, in any combination within five minutes. The enemy must be at least 100 game units away, and AntiCheat checks the half-second before the shot.

</details>

**Aimlock.** An aimlock keeps the crosshair stuck to a moving enemy. AntiCheat checks whether the crosshair stays inside a small area around the same enemy while they move, even behind a wall.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

This must happen three times within five minutes. Each time, the lock must last two seconds, stay on the enemy for at least 95% of that time, follow at least 128 game units of movement, and start at least 200 game units away.

</details>

**Triggerbot.** A triggerbot fires when the crosshair first touches an enemy. AntiCheat casts the same kind of first-hit ray through the current server hitboxes and remembers the player's last 30 damaging fresh-contact shots, whether the aim moved onto the enemy or the enemy entered a held angle.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

The previous contact with that enemy must be at least one second old, and the confirmed shot must damage that same enemy. Contact-to-damage shots in 0-1 ticks add 2 points; reactions of 2 ticks or longer remove 3 points. Detection needs 10 points and the score cannot fall below zero. Walls, misses, held sprays, unconfirmed shots, unsafe networking, possible smoke, the R8 Revolver, and the Zeus cannot change the score.

</details>

**Silentaim.** Silent aim can send a damaging shot in another direction without moving the player's visible aim there. AntiCheat checks where the player looked just before, during, and after the shot. It also allows for the weapon's normal accuracy and bullet spread.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

The detector needs 10 points within five minutes. A suspicious hit adds 2 points on the ground, 3 in the air, or 4 when it is more than 22.5 degrees past the weapon's normal limit. A headshot adds 1 more, a hit through a wall or smoke adds 2 more, and a no-scope adds 1 more. A normal hit removes 2 points.

</details>

**Inhuman Accuracy.** Nospread and rage cheats can keep hitting far more shots than a normal player. AntiCheat counts only shots fired while the crosshair is already close to a real enemy, then checks how many of those shots deal damage.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

At least 40 counted shots within five minutes. The enemy must be at least 100 game units away, and at least 90% of the shots must hit.

</details>

**Irregular Behavior.** Rage cheats can turn jump shots and no-scope sniper shots into easy kills. AntiCheat counts both hits and misses. Harder kills, such as long-range headshots and wallbangs, give more points.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

The detector needs 16 points within five minutes. It also needs at least three hard kills from at least four attempts, with a success rate of 50% or more. Kills below 10 metres do not count as successful hard kills.

</details>

### Movement

**Autostrafe.** An autostrafe cheat moves the player left and right in the air to gain or keep speed. AntiCheat compares the turns, speed, and timing across many jumps.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

The detector needs 15 suspicious jumps in the latest 20. It can detect after five suspicious jumps when at least one has more than 30 strafes per second. It can also detect when more than 90% of recent air turns follow the same perfect pattern.

</details>

**Bhop.** A bhop cheat presses jump at the exact moment the player lands, again and again. AntiCheat checks the landing time and repeated jump-button patterns. Failed jumps make the evidence weaker.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

AntiCheat starts checking after at least 20 landings. It needs either 10 perfect jumps in a row, or a score of 7 where at least 90% of seven or more jump patterns repeat the same short input pattern.

</details>

**Hyperscroll.** Hyperscroll sends a very large number of jump presses around each landing. AntiCheat checks how many presses were sent and how often they still produced a perfect jump.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

The detector needs at least 20 jump patterns and 20 checked landings. They must average at least 16 jump presses, and more than 60% of the landings must be perfect jumps.

</details>

**Nulls.** A nulls script changes between opposite movement keys, such as A and D, with perfect timing in the air. AntiCheat checks when one key is released, when the other is pressed, the player's air speed, and their frame rate.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

The detector needs at least 128 key changes and a perfect-timing score between 128 and 640 while the player moves at least 100 game units per second in the air. A lower frame rate or a normal delay between the two keys makes the detector require more evidence.

</details>

### Client behavior

**Antiaim.** Anti-aim sends view angles that normal play should not create. It can make the player look in an impossible direction, spin, repeat the same shaking pattern, or quickly turn away and back while shooting. AntiCheat gives these actions points, and the points fall over time when the behavior stops.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

The detector needs 100 points. It can also detect a steady spin of 320–999 degrees per second after 15 seconds, a steady spin of 1,000 degrees per second or more after 10 seconds, or the same shaking pattern repeating for 10 seconds.

</details>

**DLL Injection.** Some injected cheats ask the game to send them events that a normal client does not usually need. The server can see this event list, so AntiCheat compares it with a list of suspicious events.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

One match from the 117 checked events is enough. The first check runs 10 seconds after the player joins, and the next checks run every two minutes.

</details>

This detector does not scan the player's files or computer memory. It cannot find every kind of DLL injection. It only reports this one behavior that the server can see.

**Desubticking.** CS2 normally records the small time between movement changes inside each server update. Some cheats remove that time and set it to zero. AntiCheat checks how often this happens.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

The detector needs at least 30 movement commands within 20 seconds. At least 90% of them must have their small timing value set to zero. AntiCheat ignores the first 10 seconds after the player joins.

</details>

**Doubletap.** A doubletap cheat makes the same gun fire twice almost at once. AntiCheat looks for the same gun firing twice during the same server update or the next one. It also checks the player's connection before sending a punishment.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

The detector needs two fast-fire pairs. A bad connection does not hide the alert, but AntiCheat will not send the punishment command.

</details>

**Invalid CVar.** A CVar is simply a game setting. AntiCheat asks the player's game for important settings and checks whether the values are normal. This can find protected settings that were changed or values that should not be possible.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

One invalid setting is enough. AntiCheat reports it once and stays quiet until that setting becomes normal again.

</details>

**Invalid Input.** Every movement command tells the server which buttons are held and which buttons were pressed or released. AntiCheat checks whether those two parts agree. Cheats can create commands where they do not.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

The detector needs eight broken commands within five seconds.

</details>

**Namechanger.** A namechanger cheat quickly changes the player's visible name to create spam or confusion. AntiCheat counts the name changes for each player separately.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

The detector needs five visible name changes within one minute.

</details>

**Subtick Spam.** This cheat sends many movement or aim changes at exactly the same moment inside one server update. AntiCheat counts commands that repeat this unusual pattern.

<details>
<summary><strong>How strict is it?</strong></summary>

The detector needs 20 suspicious commands within half a second.

</details>

## Configuration

<details>
<summary><strong>Configuration reference</strong></summary>

The included [`AntiCheat.cfg`](cfg/AntiCheat.cfg) explains every option in plain language.

| Setting | Default | What it does |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `AntiCheat_enabled` | `1` | Master switch for AntiCheat. |
| `AntiCheat_whitelist` | empty | SteamID64s that may be detected but must never be punished. |
| `AntiCheat_*_enabled` | `1` | Enable or disable one detection module. |
| `AntiCheat_chat_announcements` | `1` | Show detections in public chat. |
| `AntiCheat_center_announcements` | `1` | Show the three-second center alert. |
| `AntiCheat_language` | `en` | Language used for public messages and Discord reports. |
| `AntiCheat_punishment_command` | `css_addban ...` | Command submitted for permanent-ban detections. |
| `AntiCheat_kick_command` | `css_kick ...` | Command submitted for kick-only detections. |
| `AntiCheat_webhook_url` | empty | Discord webhook that receives detection reports. |
| `AntiCheat_json_webhook_url` | empty | Optional HTTPS endpoint that receives neutral JSON detection reports. |
| `AntiCheat_json_webhook_bearer_token` | empty | Optional bearer token sent to the JSON endpoint. |
| `AntiCheat_webhook_role_id` | empty | Discord role to mention on a report. |
| `AntiCheat_webhook_server_address` | automatic | Server address shown in Discord. |
| `AntiCheat_webhook_logo_url` | empty | Optional public HTTPS image for Discord report branding. |
| `AntiCheat_allow_sv_cheats_testing` | `0` | Allow local detector testing with `sv_cheats 1`. Never enable this on a public server. |

Punishment commands support `{steamid64}`, `{userid}`, and `{detection}`:

```cfg
AntiCheat_punishment_command "css_addban {steamid64} 0 AntiCheat: {detection}"
AntiCheat_kick_command "css_kick #{userid} AntiCheat: {detection}"
```

Whitelist one account or a comma-separated list:

```cfg
AntiCheat_whitelist "76561198000000001,76561198000000002"
```

Set `AntiCheat_language` to one of the bundled language codes, then run `AntiCheat_reload`:

`ar`, `bg`, `cs`, `da`, `de`, `el`, `en`, `es-419`, `es-es`, `et`, `fi`, `fr`, `he`, `hr`, `hu`, `id`, `it`, `ja`, `ko`, `lt`, `lv`, `nl`, `no`, `pl`, `pt-br`, `pt-pt`, `ro`, `ru`, `sk`, `sr`, `sv`, `th`, `tr`, `uk`, `vi`, `zh-cn`, `zh-tw`.

</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>Discord webhooks</strong></summary>

1. Create a webhook in the Discord channel that should receive detections.
2. Put its URL in `AntiCheat_webhook_url`.
3. Run `AntiCheat_reload`.
4. Run `AntiCheat_webhook_test`.

Keep the webhook URL private. AntiCheat never prints it back to the console.

</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>Generic JSON webhooks</strong></summary>

1. Put your HTTPS endpoint in `AntiCheat_json_webhook_url`.
2. Optionally set `AntiCheat_json_webhook_bearer_token` to send it in the `Authorization` header.
3. Run `AntiCheat_reload`.
4. Run `AntiCheat_webhook_test` to send a harmless test event.

AntiCheat can send to Discord and the JSON endpoint at the same time. JSON reports are sent in the background, retry temporary failures once, and treat any HTTP `2xx` response as success. Responses from the endpoint are never executed as commands; punishment remains controlled locally by AntiCheat.

Each event contains `type`, `version`, `steamid64`, `player`, `detection`, `evidence`, `outcome`, `map`, `server`, `server_address`, `timestamp`, and `plugin_version`.

</details>

Both scripts make a directly installable package under the build folder's `package/game` directory. Linux builds inside the pinned Steam Runtime 3 SDK image.

</details>

`bootstrap.ps1`:

```ps1
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$amBuildCommit = 'd89ec91a7ac2607da07b50bb62346f9a10e9a998'
$toolsDirectory = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '.tools'
$amBuildDirectory = Join-Path $toolsDirectory 'ambuild'

function Confirm-Command {
	param([string]$Message)
	if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
		throw $Message
	}
}

$git = Get-Command git.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (-not $git) {
	throw 'Git is required. Install Git, reopen the terminal, and run this script again.'
}

$python = Get-Command python.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (-not $python) {
	throw 'Python 3 is required. Install Python, reopen the terminal, and run this script again.'
}
& $python.Source -c 'import sys; raise SystemExit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 8) else 1)'
Confirm-Command 'Python 3.8 or newer is required.'

Push-Location $PSScriptRoot
try {
	if (Test-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '.git')) {
		& $git.Source submodule update --init --recursive
		Confirm-Command 'The CS2 SDK or Metamod dependency could not be downloaded.'
	}
	elseif (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'hl2sdk-cs2\public')) -or
		-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'metamod-source\core'))) {
		throw 'This source copy is missing the bundled CS2 SDK or Metamod dependency.'
	}

	New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $toolsDirectory | Out-Null
	if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $amBuildDirectory '.git')) -and
		-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $amBuildDirectory 'ambuild2'))) {
		& $git.Source clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/alliedmodders/ambuild.git $amBuildDirectory
		Confirm-Command 'AMBuild could not be downloaded.'
	}

	if (Test-Path (Join-Path $amBuildDirectory '.git')) {
		$currentCommit = (& $git.Source -C $amBuildDirectory rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
		Confirm-Command 'The downloaded AMBuild checkout could not be read.'
		if ($currentCommit -ne $amBuildCommit) {
			$localChanges = & $git.Source -C $amBuildDirectory status --porcelain
			Confirm-Command 'The downloaded AMBuild checkout could not be checked.'
			if ($localChanges) {
				throw 'The local .tools/ambuild folder has changes. Remove or save them before bootstrapping again.'
			}
			& $git.Source -C $amBuildDirectory fetch --depth=1 origin $amBuildCommit
			Confirm-Command 'The pinned AMBuild revision could not be downloaded.'
			& $git.Source -C $amBuildDirectory checkout --detach $amBuildCommit
			Confirm-Command 'The pinned AMBuild revision could not be selected.'
		}
	}
}
finally {
	Pop-Location
}

Write-Host 'AntiCheat build dependencies are ready.'

```

`bootstrap.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

readonly AMBUILD_COMMIT="d89ec91a7ac2607da07b50bb62346f9a10e9a998"
readonly SOURCE_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
readonly TOOLS_DIR="$SOURCE_DIR/.tools"
readonly AMBUILD_DIR="$TOOLS_DIR/ambuild"

command -v git >/dev/null || { echo "Git is required. Install it and run this script again." >&2; exit 1; }
command -v python3 >/dev/null || { echo "Python 3 is required. Install it and run this script again." >&2; exit 1; }
python3 -c 'import sys; raise SystemExit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3, 8) else 1)' ||
  { echo "Python 3.8 or newer is required." >&2; exit 1; }

cd "$SOURCE_DIR"
if [[ -d .git ]]; then
  git submodule update --init --recursive
elif [[ ! -d hl2sdk-cs2/public || ! -d metamod-source/core ]]; then
  echo "This source copy is missing the CS2 SDK or Metamod dependency." >&2
  exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "$TOOLS_DIR"
if [[ ! -d "$AMBUILD_DIR/.git" && ! -d "$AMBUILD_DIR/ambuild2" ]]; then
  git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/alliedmodders/ambuild.git "$AMBUILD_DIR"
fi

if [[ -d "$AMBUILD_DIR/.git" ]]; then
  current_commit="$(git -C "$AMBUILD_DIR" rev-parse HEAD)"
  if [[ "$current_commit" != "$AMBUILD_COMMIT" ]]; then
    [[ -z "$(git -C "$AMBUILD_DIR" status --porcelain)" ]] ||
      { echo "The local .tools/ambuild folder has changes. Remove or save them before bootstrapping again." >&2; exit 1; }
    git -C "$AMBUILD_DIR" fetch --depth=1 origin "$AMBUILD_COMMIT"
    git -C "$AMBUILD_DIR" checkout --detach "$AMBUILD_COMMIT"
  fi
fi

echo "AntiCheat build dependencies are ready."

```

`build-linux.ps1`:

```ps1
param(
	[string]$BuildDirectory = 'AntiCheat/build-linux-release',
	[string]$MetaModSourceDirectory = 'metamod-source',
	[switch]$SkipBootstrap
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$requiredMetaModCommit = '170058a2f0dbd58106b7c76bfe88a94672295356'
$requiredAMBuildCommit = 'd89ec91a7ac2607da07b50bb62346f9a10e9a998'

if ($BuildDirectory -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*$') {
	throw 'BuildDirectory must be a safe repository-relative path using letters, numbers, underscores, dashes, and forward slashes.'
}
if (-not (Get-Command docker.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
	throw 'Docker Desktop is required for the Linux build.'
}

$buildPath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot ($BuildDirectory.Replace('/', '\'))
$metaModSourcePath = $MetaModSourceDirectory
if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($metaModSourcePath)) {
	$metaModSourcePath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $metaModSourcePath
}
$metaModSourcePath = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($metaModSourcePath)
$amBuildPath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '.tools\ambuild'
if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $metaModSourcePath 'core'))) {
	throw "MetaMod:Source checkout is missing or invalid at $metaModSourcePath."
}
$git = Get-Command git.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (-not $git) {
	throw 'Git is required to verify the pinned MetaMod:Source revision.'
}
$metaModRevision = (& $git.Source -C $metaModSourcePath rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $metaModRevision -ne $requiredMetaModCommit) {
	throw "MetaMod:Source must be checked out at $requiredMetaModCommit (found $metaModRevision). Use an isolated checkout; do not update a pre-existing dependency directory."
}
if (-not $SkipBootstrap) {
	& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'bootstrap.ps1')
}
else {
	if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'hl2sdk-cs2\public'))) {
		throw 'The CS2 SDK is missing; run bootstrap.ps1 or provide a prepared source checkout.'
	}
	if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '.tools\ambuild\ambuild2'))) {
		throw 'Pinned AMBuild is missing; run bootstrap.ps1 or provide a prepared source checkout.'
	}
	$amBuildRevision = (& $git.Source -C $amBuildPath rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
	if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $amBuildRevision -ne $requiredAMBuildCommit) {
		throw "Pinned AMBuild must be checked out at $requiredAMBuildCommit (found $amBuildRevision)."
	}
}

$image = 'registry.gitlab.steamos.cloud/steamrt/sniper/sdk@sha256:2969e5a47146a6494c01d953cd818b1d62712f42f9e54c4809d7a3aa8dc276ce'
$docker = (Get-Command docker.exe).Source
$sourcePath = $PSScriptRoot
& $docker version --format '{{.Server.Version}}' | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
	throw 'Docker Desktop is not running with its Linux container engine.'
}

$build = ('set -eu; export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get update >/dev/null; ' +
	'apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends lld >/dev/null; export PYTHONPATH=/opt/ambuild; ' +
	"python3 configure.py --enable-optimize --metamod-source /metamod-source --out $BuildDirectory; " +
	"python3 -c 'from ambuild2.run import cli_run; cli_run()' $BuildDirectory")

& $docker run --rm `
	--mount "type=bind,source=$sourcePath,target=/workspace" `
	--mount "type=bind,source=$metaModSourcePath,target=/metamod-source,readonly" `
	--mount "type=bind,source=$amBuildPath,target=/opt/ambuild,readonly" `
	--workdir /workspace $image bash -lc $build
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
	throw 'The Linux SteamRT3 build failed.'
}

$plugin = Join-Path $buildPath 'package\game\csgo\addons\AntiCheat\bin\linuxsteamrt64\AntiCheat.so'
if (-not (Test-Path $plugin)) {
	throw 'The build finished without producing AntiCheat.so.'
}
Write-Host "Linux package ready: $plugin"

`build-linux.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

readonly BUILD_DIR="${1:-AntiCheat/build-linux-release}"
readonly SOURCE_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
METAMOD_SOURCE_INPUT="${2:-$SOURCE_DIR/metamod-source}"
readonly SKIP_BOOTSTRAP="${3:-}"
readonly IMAGE="registry.gitlab.steamos.cloud/steamrt/sniper/sdk@sha256:2969e5a47146a6494c01d953cd818b1d62712f42f9e54c4809d7a3aa8dc276ce"
readonly REQUIRED_METAMOD_COMMIT="170058a2f0dbd58106b7c76bfe88a94672295356"
readonly REQUIRED_AMBUILD_COMMIT="d89ec91a7ac2607da07b50bb62346f9a10e9a998"

[[ "$BUILD_DIR" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*$ ]] ||
  { echo "BUILD_DIR must be a safe repository-relative path using letters, numbers, underscores, dashes, and forward slashes." >&2; exit 1; }
command -v docker >/dev/null ||
  { echo "Docker is required for the Linux Steam Runtime build." >&2; exit 1; }

if [[ "$METAMOD_SOURCE_INPUT" != /* ]]; then
  METAMOD_SOURCE_INPUT="$SOURCE_DIR/$METAMOD_SOURCE_INPUT"
fi
[[ -d "$METAMOD_SOURCE_INPUT/core" ]] ||
  { echo "MetaMod:Source checkout is missing or invalid at $METAMOD_SOURCE_INPUT." >&2; exit 1; }
METAMOD_SOURCE_DIR="$(cd -- "$METAMOD_SOURCE_INPUT" && pwd)"
command -v git >/dev/null ||
  { echo "Git is required to verify the pinned MetaMod:Source revision." >&2; exit 1; }
METAMOD_REVISION="$(git -C "$METAMOD_SOURCE_DIR" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" ||
  { echo "Could not read the MetaMod:Source Git revision at $METAMOD_SOURCE_DIR." >&2; exit 1; }
[[ "$METAMOD_REVISION" == "$REQUIRED_METAMOD_COMMIT" ]] ||
  { echo "MetaMod:Source must be checked out at $REQUIRED_METAMOD_COMMIT (found $METAMOD_REVISION). Use an isolated checkout." >&2; exit 1; }
if [[ "$SKIP_BOOTSTRAP" == "--skip-bootstrap" ]]; then
  [[ -d "$SOURCE_DIR/hl2sdk-cs2/public" && -d "$SOURCE_DIR/.tools/ambuild/ambuild2" ]] ||
    { echo "The CS2 SDK or pinned AMBuild is missing; run bootstrap.sh or provide prepared inputs." >&2; exit 1; }
  AMBUILD_REVISION="$(git -C "$SOURCE_DIR/.tools/ambuild" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" ||
    { echo "Could not read the pinned AMBuild Git revision." >&2; exit 1; }
  [[ "$AMBUILD_REVISION" == "$REQUIRED_AMBUILD_COMMIT" ]] ||
    { echo "AMBuild must be checked out at $REQUIRED_AMBUILD_COMMIT (found $AMBUILD_REVISION)." >&2; exit 1; }
else
  "$SOURCE_DIR/bootstrap.sh"
fi
docker version --format '{{.Server.Version}}' >/dev/null

docker run --rm \
  -v "$SOURCE_DIR:/workspace" \
  -v "$METAMOD_SOURCE_DIR:/metamod-source:ro" \
  -v "$SOURCE_DIR/.tools/ambuild:/opt/ambuild:ro" \
  -w /workspace \
  "$IMAGE" bash -lc "
    set -eu
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive PYTHONPATH=/opt/ambuild
    apt-get update >/dev/null
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends lld >/dev/null
    python3 configure.py --enable-optimize --metamod-source /metamod-source --out '$BUILD_DIR'
    python3 -c 'from ambuild2.run import cli_run; cli_run()' '$BUILD_DIR'
  "

plugin="$SOURCE_DIR/$BUILD_DIR/package/game/csgo/addons/AntiCheat/bin/linuxsteamrt64/AntiCheat.so"
[[ -f "$plugin" ]] || { echo "The build finished without producing AntiCheat.so." >&2; exit 1; }
echo "Linux package ready: $plugin"

`build-windows.ps1`:

```ps1
param(
	[string]$BuildDirectory = 'build-windows-release'
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

if ($BuildDirectory -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$') {
	throw 'The build folder name may only contain letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and dashes.'
}

& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'bootstrap.ps1')

$vswhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path $vswhere)) {
	throw 'Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools with the C++ workload are required for the Windows build.'
}

$vcvars = & $vswhere -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 `
	-find 'VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat' | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $vcvars) {
	throw 'The 64-bit Microsoft C++ compiler could not be found. Add the C++ workload to Visual Studio Build Tools.'
}

$environment = & cmd.exe /d /c "call `"$vcvars`" >nul && set"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
	throw 'The Microsoft C++ build environment could not be started.'
}
foreach ($line in $environment) {
	if ($line -match '^([^=]+)=(.*)$') {
		Set-Item -Path "Env:$($matches[1])" -Value $matches[2]
	}
}

$python = (Get-Command python.exe).Source
$subst = (Get-Command subst.exe).Source
# AMBuild puts absolute paths in object filenames, so a drive alias keeps them below Windows' limit.
$shortDrive = @('Z:', 'Y:', 'X:', 'W:', 'V:', 'U:', 'T:') |
	Where-Object { -not (Test-Path "$_\") } |
	Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $shortDrive) {
	throw 'A free drive letter could not be found for the Windows build.'
}

& $subst $shortDrive $PSScriptRoot
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
	throw 'A short path could not be created for the Windows build.'
}

$shortRoot = "$shortDrive\"
$env:PYTHONPATH = Join-Path $shortRoot '.tools\ambuild'
$configuredBuild = Join-Path $shortRoot "$BuildDirectory\.ambuild2\graph"
$locationPushed = $false

try {
	Push-Location $shortRoot
	$locationPushed = $true
	if (-not (Test-Path $configuredBuild)) {
		& $python configure.py --enable-optimize --out $BuildDirectory
		if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
			throw 'The Windows build could not be configured.'
		}
	}
	& $python -c 'from ambuild2.run import cli_run; cli_run()' $BuildDirectory
	if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
		throw 'The Windows build failed.'
	}
}
finally {
	if ($locationPushed) {
		Pop-Location
	}
	& $subst $shortDrive /d
	if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
		Write-Warning "The temporary $shortDrive build path could not be removed."
	}
}

$plugin = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "$BuildDirectory\package\game\csgo\addons\AntiCheat\bin\win64\AntiCheat.dll"
if (-not (Test-Path $plugin)) {
	throw 'The build finished without producing AntiCheat.dll.'
}
Write-Host "Windows package ready: $plugin"

```

`check-translations.py`:

```py
from pathlib import Path
import re


root = Path(__file__).with_name("translations")
languages = {
    "ar", "bg", "cs", "da", "de", "el", "en", "es-419", "es-es", "et",
    "fi", "fr", "he", "hr", "hu", "id", "it", "ja", "ko", "lt", "lv",
    "nl", "no", "pl", "pt-br", "pt-pt", "ro", "ru", "sk", "sr", "sv",
    "th", "tr", "uk", "vi", "zh-cn", "zh-tw",
}
entry = re.compile(r'^\s*"([^"\\]+)"\s+"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"\s*$')
# These tokens are chat formatting directives, not translation arguments.
placeholder = re.compile(r"\{[A-Za-z0-9_.]+\}")
chat_markup = {"red", "lime", "grey", "blue", "default"}
evidence_template_limit = 700  # Discord allows 1024 characters; dynamic values need the remaining space.
technical_compact_keys = {
    "evidence.aimbot.snap_return",
    "evidence.aimbot.convergence",
    "evidence.aimbot.smooth",
    "evidence.silentaim",
    "evidence.triggerbot",
    "evidence.antiaim.category_entry",
    "webhook.field.steamid64",
}
aimbot_score_keys = {
    "evidence.aimbot.latest.snap_return",
    "evidence.aimbot.latest.convergence",
    "evidence.aimbot.latest.smooth",
}


def load(path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    phrases: dict[str, str] = {}
    for number, line in enumerate(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), 1):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped or stripped in {'"Phrases"', "{", "}"}:
            continue
        match = entry.fullmatch(line)
        if not match:
            raise ValueError(f"{path}:{number}: malformed KeyValues entry")
        key, value = match.groups()
        if key in phrases:
            raise ValueError(f"{path}:{number}: duplicate phrase {key}")
        phrases[key] = value
    return phrases


def placeholders(value: str) -> set[str]:
    return {match[1:-1] for match in placeholder.findall(value) if match[1:-1] not in chat_markup}


files = {path.stem for path in root.glob("*.txt")}
if files != languages:
    raise ValueError(f"language files differ: missing={languages - files}, extra={files - languages}")

english = load(root / "en.txt")
for key in aimbot_score_keys:
    if "score" not in placeholders(english[key]) or "incidents" in placeholders(english[key]):
        raise ValueError(f"{key} must expose the weighted score, not an incident count")
source = "\n".join(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for path in root.parent.joinpath("src").rglob("*.cpp"))
source_keys = set(re.findall(r'"((?:announcement|evidence|webhook)\.[A-Za-z0-9_.]+)"', source))
source_keys.discard("webhook.h")
if source_keys != english.keys():
    raise ValueError(
        f"English phrases differ from source: missing={source_keys - english.keys()}, "
        f"unused={english.keys() - source_keys}"
    )

raw_localized_mutations = re.findall(
    r"\.localized\s*(?:\+=|=)|\.localized\.(?:append|assign|insert|replace)\s*\(",
    source,
)
if raw_localized_mutations:
    raise ValueError("localized text must be composed through localization::Text instead of being mutated directly")

watermark_languages = set(re.findall(r'^\s*\{"([^"]+)", "[^"]*\{author\}[^"]*"\},$', source, re.MULTILINE))
if watermark_languages != languages:
    raise ValueError(
        f"hardcoded watermark languages differ: missing={languages - watermark_languages}, "
        f"extra={watermark_languages - languages}"
    )

for path in sorted(root.glob("*.txt")):
    phrases = load(path)
    if phrases.keys() != english.keys():
        raise ValueError(
            f"{path}: phrase keys differ: missing={english.keys() - phrases.keys()}, "
            f"extra={phrases.keys() - english.keys()}"
        )
    for key, value in phrases.items():
        if placeholders(value) != placeholders(english[key]):
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: placeholders differ for {key}")
        if "@{" in value:
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: stray @ before placeholder for {key}")
        if "?" in value:
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: replacement character '?' in {key}")
        if path.stem != "en" and value == english[key] and len(value) > 30 and key not in technical_compact_keys:
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: untranslated English phrase for {key}")
        if key.startswith("evidence.") and len(value) > evidence_template_limit:
            raise ValueError(f"{path}: {key} is too long for a readable Discord evidence field")

print(f"Checked {len(files)} languages with {len(english)} phrases each.")

```

`configure.py`:

```py
# vim: set sts=2 ts=8 sw=2 tw=99 et:
import sys

try:
  from ambuild2 import run
except ImportError:
  sys.stderr.write('AMBuild 2 is required to build AntiCheat.\n')
  sys.exit(1)

if getattr(run, 'CURRENT_API', '2.1').startswith('2.1'):
  sys.stderr.write('AMBuild 2.2 or newer is required to build AntiCheat.\n')
  sys.exit(1)

parser = run.BuildParser(sourcePath=sys.path[0], api='2.2')
parser.options.add_argument('--metamod-source', dest='metamod_source', default=None,
                            help='Path to the pinned MetaMod:Source checkout')
parser.options.add_argument('--enable-debug', action='store_const', const='1', dest='debug',
                            help='Enable debugging symbols')
parser.options.add_argument('--enable-optimize', action='store_const', const='1', dest='opt',
                            help='Enable compiler optimization')
parser.Configure()

`package-source.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3

import argparse
import os
import re
import subprocess
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath


VERSION = "1.0.0"
AMBUILD_COMMIT = "d89ec91a7ac2607da07b50bb62346f9a10e9a998"
ARCHIVE_ROOT = f"AntiCheat-{VERSION}-source"


def git(repo: Path, *args: str, text: bool = True):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(repo), *args], text=text)


def require_clean(repo: Path, name: str) -> None:
    if git(repo, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no").strip():
        raise SystemExit(f"{name} has tracked changes. Commit them before creating the source package.")


def tracked_files(repo: Path, prefix: PurePosixPath):
    output = git(repo, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z", text=False)
    for record in output.split(b"\0"):
        if not record:
            continue
        metadata, relative = record.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode = metadata.split(b" ", 1)[0].decode()
        if mode == "160000":
            continue
        relative_path = Path(os.fsdecode(relative))
        yield repo / relative_path, prefix / PurePosixPath(relative_path.as_posix()), mode


def submodules(root: Path):
    result = []
    for line in git(root, "submodule", "status", "--recursive").splitlines():
        if not line or line[0] != " ":
            raise SystemExit(f"A submodule is not at its recorded commit: {line.strip()}")
        commit, relative = line[1:].split(maxsplit=2)[:2]
        path = root / Path(relative)
        if git(path, "rev-parse", "HEAD").strip() != commit:
            raise SystemExit(f"The {relative} submodule is not at its recorded commit.")
        require_clean(path, relative)
        result.append((path, PurePosixPath(relative), commit))
    return result


def file_bytes(path: Path, mode: str) -> bytes:
    if mode == "120000":
        return os.readlink(path).encode()
    return path.read_bytes()


def add_file(archive: zipfile.ZipFile, name: PurePosixPath, source: Path, mode: str, timestamp) -> None:
    info = zipfile.ZipInfo(f"{ARCHIVE_ROOT}/{name.as_posix()}", timestamp)
    info.create_system = 3
    permissions = 0o120777 if mode == "120000" else (0o100755 if mode == "100755" else 0o100644)
    info.external_attr = permissions << 16
    info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
    archive.writestr(info, file_bytes(source, mode), compresslevel=9)


def add_text(archive: zipfile.ZipFile, name: str, content: str, timestamp) -> None:
    info = zipfile.ZipInfo(f"{ARCHIVE_ROOT}/{name}", timestamp)
    info.create_system = 3
    info.external_attr = 0o644 << 16
    info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
    archive.writestr(info, content.encode(), compresslevel=9)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Create the complete AntiCheat source archive.")
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    require_clean(root, "AntiCheat")
    commit = git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()
    commit_time = int(git(root, "show", "-s", "--format=%ct", "HEAD").strip())
    timestamp = tuple(__import__("time").gmtime(max(commit_time, 315532800))[:6])

    dependencies = submodules(root)
    ambuild = root / ".tools" / "ambuild"
    if not (ambuild / "ambuild2").is_dir():
        raise SystemExit("Pinned AMBuild is missing. Run bootstrap.sh or bootstrap.ps1 first.")
    require_clean(ambuild, "AMBuild")
    ambuild_commit = git(ambuild, "rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()
    if ambuild_commit != AMBUILD_COMMIT:
        raise SystemExit("AMBuild is not at the revision pinned by AntiCheat.")

    image_match = re.search(r'IMAGE="([^"]+)"', (root / "build-linux.sh").read_text())
    if not image_match:
        raise SystemExit("The pinned Steam Runtime image could not be read.")

    entries = list(tracked_files(root, PurePosixPath()))
    for path, prefix, _ in dependencies:
        entries.extend(tracked_files(path, prefix))
    entries.extend(tracked_files(ambuild, PurePosixPath(".tools/ambuild")))
    entries.sort(key=lambda entry: entry[1].as_posix())

    names = [entry[1].as_posix() for entry in entries]
    if len(names) != len(set(names)):
        raise SystemExit("The source package contains duplicate paths.")
    required = {
        "licenses/CLIENTCVARVALUE-GPL-3.0.txt",
        "licenses/CS2KZ-AGPL-3.0.txt",
        "licenses/DYNLIBUTILS-MIT.txt",
    }
    if not required.issubset(names):
        raise SystemExit("The source package is missing a required legal file.")

    metadata = [
        f"AntiCheat version: {VERSION}",
        f"AntiCheat commit: {commit}",
        f"AMBuild commit: {ambuild_commit}",
        f"Steam Runtime image: {image_match.group(1)}",
        "",
        "Git submodules:",
    ]
    metadata.extend(f"{prefix.as_posix()}: {revision}" for _, prefix, revision in dependencies)
    metadata.append("")

    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(args.output, "w", allowZip64=True) as archive:
        for source, name, mode in entries:
            add_file(archive, name, source, mode, timestamp)
        add_text(archive, "SOURCE_DEPENDENCIES.txt", "\n".join(metadata), timestamp)

    with zipfile.ZipFile(args.output) as archive:
        broken = archive.testzip()
        if broken:
            raise SystemExit(f"The source package failed its integrity check at {broken}.")

    print(f"Source package ready: {args.output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

	static constexpr const char *detectionNames[] = {
		"AIMBOT",    "AIMLOCK",     "ANTIAIM",          "AUTOSTRAFE",   "BHOP",          "DLL INJECTION",      "DESUBTICKING",
		"DOUBLETAP", "HYPERSCROLL", "INHUMAN ACCURACY", "INVALID CVAR", "INVALID INPUT", "IRREGULAR BEHAVIOR", "NAMECHANGER",
		"NULLS",     "SILENTAIM",   "SUBTICK SPAM",     "TRIGGERBOT",
	};
	static_assert(AntiCheat_ARRAYSIZE(detectionNames) == static_cast<size_t>(DetectionType::Count));

	void HandleDetectionCallback(const char *detection, MovementPlayer *player, const localization::Text &evidence)
	{
		g_AntiCheat.HandleDetection(detection, player, evidence);
	}

	void HandleNetworkVetoDetectionCallback(const char *detection, MovementPlayer *player, const localization::Text &evidence)
	{
		g_AntiCheat.HandleDetection(detection, player, evidence, false, true);
	}

	bool IsKickOnlyDetection(const char *detection)
	{
		return AntiCheat_STREQI(detection, "DESUBTICKING") || AntiCheat_STREQI(detection, "NULLS") || AntiCheat_STREQI(detection, "SUBTICK SPAM");
	}

	void ReplaceAll(std::string &value, const std::string &placeholder, const std::string &replacement)
	{
		for (size_t position = 0; (position = value.find(placeholder, position)) != std::string::npos; position += replacement.size())
		{
			value.replace(position, placeholder.size(), replacement);
		}
	}

	std::string SanitizeConsoleText(const char *value)
	{
		std::string safe = value ? value : "<unknown>";
		for (char &character : safe)
		{
			const auto byte = static_cast<unsigned char>(character);
			if (byte < 32 || byte == 127)
			{
				character = '?';
			}
		}
		return safe;
	}

	int CheckCommandTemplate(const char *settingName, const char *commandTemplate, bool requireSteamId)
	{
		if (!commandTemplate || !*commandTemplate)
		{
			Msg("[AntiCheat] Review %s: it is empty, so this punishment is disabled.\n", settingName);
			return 1;
		}

		int findings = 0;
		bool hasSteamId = false;
		bool hasUserId = false;
		const std::string command = commandTemplate;
		if (command.front() == '"' || command.back() == '"')
		{
			Msg("[AntiCheat] Review %s: the command itself starts or ends with a quote. Keep only the cfg value's outer quotes.\n", settingName);
			++findings;
		}
		for (size_t position = 0; position < command.size();)
		{
			const size_t open = command.find('{', position);
			const size_t close = command.find('}', position);
			if (close != std::string::npos && (open == std::string::npos || close < open))
			{
				Msg("[AntiCheat] Review %s: it contains an unmatched closing brace.\n", settingName);
				++findings;
				position = close + 1;
				continue;
			}
			if (open == std::string::npos)
			{
				break;
			}
			const size_t placeholderEnd = command.find('}', open + 1);
			if (placeholderEnd == std::string::npos)
			{
				Msg("[AntiCheat] Review %s: it contains an unmatched opening brace.\n", settingName);
				++findings;
				break;
			}

			const std::string placeholder = command.substr(open, placeholderEnd - open + 1);
			hasSteamId |= placeholder == "{steamid64}";
			hasUserId |= placeholder == "{userid}";
			if (placeholder != "{steamid64}" && placeholder != "{userid}" && placeholder != "{detection}")
			{
				Msg("[AntiCheat] Review %s: %s is not a supported placeholder.\n", settingName, SanitizeConsoleText(placeholder.c_str()).c_str());
				++findings;
			}
			position = placeholderEnd + 1;
		}

		if (requireSteamId && !hasSteamId)
		{
			Msg("[AntiCheat] Review %s: permanent bans need the {steamid64} placeholder.\n", settingName);
			++findings;
		}
		if (!requireSteamId && !hasSteamId && !hasUserId)
		{
			Msg("[AntiCheat] Review %s: kicks need either {userid} or {steamid64}.\n", settingName);
			++findings;
		}

		std::string expanded = command;
		ReplaceAll(expanded, "{steamid64}", "18446744073709551615");
		ReplaceAll(expanded, "{userid}", "2147483647");
		ReplaceAll(expanded, "{detection}", "IRREGULAR BEHAVIOR");
		if (expanded.size() >= static_cast<size_t>(CCommand::MaxCommandLength()))
		{
			Msg("[AntiCheat] Review %s: its expanded command can exceed the engine limit.\n", settingName);
			++findings;
		}
		return findings;
	}

	f64 ConfigLoadTimeout()
	{
		g_AntiCheat.ReportConfigLoadTimeout();
		return 0.0;
	}

	void AddOffsetRequirement(const char *key, const char *plainName, std::vector<std::string> &missing)
	{
		if (!g_pGameConfig || g_pGameConfig->GetOffset(key) < 0)
		{

		}
	}

	struct SchemaRequirement

			{"CBaseEntity", "m_iTeamNum"},
			{"CBaseEntity", "m_lifeState"},
			{"CBaseEntity", "m_MoveType"},
			{"CBaseEntity", "m_nActualMoveType"},
			{"CBaseEntity", "m_nSubclassID"},
			{"CBaseEntity", "m_pCollision"},

			{"CBaseEntity", "m_vecBaseVelocity"},

			{"CBasePlayerPawn", "m_pMovementServices"},
			{"CBasePlayerPawn", "m_pWeaponServices"},
			{"CBasePlayerPawn", "v_angle"},
			{"CBodyComponent", "m_pSceneNode"},

			{"CCollisionProperty", "m_CollisionGroup"},
			{"CCSPlayer_MovementServices", "m_bDucked"},
			{"CCSPlayer_MovementServices", "m_ModernJump"},
			{"CCSPlayer_MovementServices", "m_vecLadderNormal"},

			{"CCSPlayerModernJump", "m_flLastLandedFrac"},
			{"CCSPlayerModernJump", "m_flLastUsableJumpPressFrac"},
			{"CCSPlayerModernJump", "m_nLastLandedTick"},
			{"CCSPlayerModernJump", "m_nLastUsableJumpPressTick"},

			{"CCSPlayerPawn", "m_entitySpottedState"},

			{"CCSWeaponBaseVData", "m_flCycleTime"},
			{"CGameSceneNode", "m_vecAbsOrigin"},
			{"EntitySpottedState_t", "m_bSpottedByMask"},

			{"VPhysicsCollisionAttribute_t", "m_nHierarchyId"},
			{"VPhysicsCollisionAttribute_t", "m_nInteractsWith"},

		for (const auto &requirement : requirements)
		{

				missing.emplace_back(std::string("The required player data field ") + requirement.className + "." + requirement.fieldName
									 + " is unavailable.");
			}
		}
	}

	std::string JoinReasons(const std::vector<std::string> &missing)
	{
		std::string message = "[AntiCheat] AntiCheat did not load.";
		for (const auto &reason : missing)
		{
			message += " ";
			message += reason;
		}
		return message;
	}

bool AntiCheatPlugin::Load(PluginId id, ISmmAPI *ismm, char *error, size_t maxlen, bool late)
{
	PLUGIN_SAVEVARS();
	if (!settings::Initialize())
	{
		if (error && maxlen)
		{
			snprintf(error, maxlen, "AntiCheat could not reserve memory for its settings.");
		}
		return false;
	}
	webhook = new (std::nothrow) WebhookService;
	if (!webhook)
	{
		settings::Shutdown();
		if (error && maxlen)
		{
			snprintf(error, maxlen, "AntiCheat could not reserve memory for Discord reports.");
		}
		return false;
	}
	if (late)
	{
		if (!Activate(error, maxlen, true))
		{
			CleanupRuntime();
			return false;
		}
		ismm->AddListener(this, this);
	}
	else
	{
		// The game DLL finishes registering its messages and events after this early callback.
		activationPending = true;
	}
	return true;
}

void AntiCheatPlugin::AllPluginsLoaded()
{
	if (!activationPending)
	{
		return;
	}

	activationPending = false;
	char error[1024] {};
	if (!Activate(error, sizeof(error), false))
	{
		activationError = error[0] ? error : "AntiCheat could not finish loading after the game became ready.";
		Msg("[AntiCheat] AntiCheat is not running. %s\n", activationError.c_str());
		return;
	}
	g_SMAPI->AddListener(this, this);
}

bool AntiCheatPlugin::QueryRunning(char *error, size_t maxlen)
{
	if (loaded)
	{
		return true;
	}
	const char *reason = activationError.empty() ? "AntiCheat is waiting for the game to finish starting." : activationError.c_str();
	if (error && maxlen)
	{
		snprintf(error, maxlen, "%s", reason);
	}
	return false;
}

bool AntiCheatPlugin::Activate(char *error, size_t maxlen, bool late)
{
	std::vector<std::string> missing;
	if (!KHook::__exported__khook)
	{
		missing.emplace_back("Metamod's KHook service is unavailable.");
	}

	modules::Initialize(missing);
	interfaces::Initialize(g_SMAPI, missing);
	utils::Initialize(missing);

	if (g_pCVar && !convarsRegistered)
	{
		META_CONVAR_REGISTER(FCVAR_RELEASE);
		convarsRegistered = true;
	}

	if (g_pGameConfig)
	{
		AddOffsetRequirement("GameEntitySystem", "game entity system", missing);
		AddOffsetRequirement("Teleport", "player teleport", missing);
		AddOffsetRequirement("IsEntityPawn", "player pawn check", missing);
		AddOffsetRequirement("IsEntityController", "player controller check", missing);
		AddOffsetRequirement("ClientOffset", "player list", missing);
	}

	if (g_pNetworkMessages && !g_pNetworkMessages->FindNetworkMessagePartial("TextMsg"))
	{
		missing.emplace_back("The chat message used for detection announcements is unavailable.");
	}
	if (g_pNetworkMessages && !g_pNetworkMessages->FindNetworkMessageById(GE_Source1LegacyGameEvent))
	{
		missing.emplace_back("The center-screen event message used for detection announcements is unavailable.");
	}
	if (g_pNetworkMessages && !g_pNetworkMessages->FindNetworkMessageById(GE_FireBulletsId))
	{
		missing.emplace_back("The exact weapon firing data used by Silentaim is unavailable.");
	}
	if (g_pNetworkMessages && !g_pNetworkMessages->FindNetworkMessageById(GE_PlayerBulletHitId))
	{
		missing.emplace_back("The exact bullet-hit context used by Aimbot is unavailable.");
	}
	if (g_pCVar)
	{
		movement_settings::Validate(missing);
		ConVarRefAbstract svCheats("sv_cheats", true);
		if (!svCheats.IsValidRef() || !svCheats.IsConVarDataAvailable())
		{
			missing.emplace_back("The server variable sv_cheats is not available.");
		}
	}
	if (modules::server && modules::server->m_hModule && !modules::server->FindVirtualTable("CNavPhysicsInterface"))
	{
		missing.emplace_back("The movement trace interface could not be found.");
	}
	if (modules::server && modules::server->m_hModule && !modules::server->FindVirtualTable("CTraceFilterPlayerMovementCS"))
	{
		missing.emplace_back("The player movement trace filter could not be found.");
	}
	AddSchemaRequirements(missing);
	movement::ValidateDetours(missing);

	char clientCvarError[512] {};
	if (!g_ClientCvarValue.Validate(interfaces::pEngine, g_pNetworkMessages, clientCvarError, sizeof(clientCvarError)))
	{
		missing.emplace_back(clientCvarError[0] ? clientCvarError : "Player setting checks are unavailable.");
	}

	if (!missing.empty())
	{
		const std::string message = JoinReasons(missing);
		for (const auto &reason : missing)
		{
			Msg("[AntiCheat] %s\n", reason.c_str());
		}
		if (error && maxlen)
		{
			snprintf(error, maxlen, "%s", message.c_str());
		}
		CleanupRuntime(false);
		return false;
	}

	bool clientCvarsReady =
		g_ClientCvarValue.Load(interfaces::pEngine, g_pNetworkMessages, interfaces::pGameEventSystem, clientCvarError, sizeof(clientCvarError));
	if (!clientCvarsReady)
	{
		missing.emplace_back(clientCvarError[0] ? clientCvarError : "Player setting checks could not be started.");
	}
	else
	{
		g_pClientCvarValue = g_ClientCvarValue.GetInterface();
	}
	if (!clientCvarsReady)
	{
		const std::string message = JoinReasons(missing);
		for (const auto &reason : missing)
		{
			Msg("[AntiCheat] %s\n", reason.c_str());
		}
		if (error && maxlen)
		{
			snprintf(error, maxlen, "%s", message.c_str());
		}
		CleanupRuntime(false);
		return false;
	}

	MovementDetectionService::InitSvCheatsWatcher();
	svCheatsWatcherInstalled = true;
	detectionSystem.Load(HandleDetectionCallback, HandleNetworkVetoDetectionCallback);
	hooks::Initialize(missing);

	if (!missing.empty())
	{
		const std::string message = JoinReasons(missing);
		for (const auto &reason : missing)
		{
			Msg("[AntiCheat] %s\n", reason.c_str());
		}
		if (error && maxlen)
		{
			snprintf(error, maxlen, "%s", message.c_str());
		}
		CleanupRuntime(false);
		return false;
	}

	// Install raw detours last so no later startup failure can leave one behind.
	if (!movement::InitDetours(missing))
	{
		const std::string message = JoinReasons(missing);
		for (const auto &reason : missing)
		{
			Msg("[AntiCheat] %s\n", reason.c_str());
		}
		if (error && maxlen)
		{
			snprintf(error, maxlen, "%s", message.c_str());
		}
		CleanupRuntime(false);
		return false;
	}

	loaded = true;
	ResetRuntime();
	configReloadPending = true;
	configLoadFailed = false;
	settings::ExecuteConfig();
	StartTimer(ConfigLoadTimeout, 5.0, true, true);
	if (late)
	{
		for (i32 i = 1; i <= MAXPLAYERS; ++i)
		{
			auto *player = g_pAntiCheatPlayerManager->ToPlayer(static_cast<u32>(i));
			if (player && player->IsInGame())
			{
				g_pAntiCheatPlayerManager->OnClientActive(player->GetPlayerSlot(), player->GetSteamId64(false));
				g_pAntiCheatPlayerManager->OnClientFullyConnect(player->GetPlayerSlot());
				g_ClientCvarValue.OnClientFullyConnected(player->GetPlayerSlot(), player->IsFakeClient());
				OnClientFullyConnect(player->GetPlayerSlot());
			}
		}
		hooks::HookActivePlayers();
	}
	Msg("[AntiCheat] AntiCheat %s loaded successfully. Waiting for AntiCheat.cfg to finish.\n", PLUGIN_FULL_VERSION);
	return true;
}

bool AntiCheatPlugin::Unload(char *error, size_t maxlen)
{
	if (!FlushAllDetours())
	{
		const char *reason = "AntiCheat could not unload because one of its server hooks could not be removed safely.";
		if (error && maxlen)
		{
			snprintf(error, maxlen, "%s", reason);
		}
		Msg("[AntiCheat] %s\n", reason);
		return false;
	}
	CleanupRuntime();
	Msg("[AntiCheat] AntiCheat unloaded successfully.\n");
	return true;
}

bool AntiCheatPlugin::Pause(char *error, size_t maxlen)
{
	const char *reason = "AntiCheat cannot be paused safely. Unload it instead.";
	if (error && maxlen)
	{
		snprintf(error, maxlen, "%s", reason);
	}
	return false;
}

bool AntiCheatPlugin::Unpause(char *error, size_t maxlen)
{
	const char *reason = "AntiCheat is not paused.";
	if (error && maxlen)
	{
		snprintf(error, maxlen, "%s", reason);
	}
	return false;
}
